headline: Bernanke on *independent* central banks
quote: a central bank which is independent can ignore short-term political pressures
title: Fed Chair Bernanke: Why central banks must remain independent
caption: Former Fed Chair Ben Bernanke highlighted the historical significance of central bank independence from political influence. He explained that independence allows policy makers to focus on long-term economic stability rather than short-term election cycles.
comment: Do you think central banks should remain independent of political influence?
